prompt: how many stores are there and which one has the most clients, do not count online
title: Store Count and Top Clients
summary: Determine how many physical stores there are, excluding online, and identify which store has the most clients.
executed_sql_queries:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count_by_store
FROM retail.customers c
JOIN retail.stores s
  ON c.primary_store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_name <> 'Zava Retail Online'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id;

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count_by_store
FROM retail.customers c
JOIN retail.stores s
  ON c.primary_store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_name <> 'Zava Retail Online'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY customer_count_by_store DESC, s.store_id;
